title: Adorable 1-Bedroom Guesthouse
description:
Enjoy a comfy, private spot & easy to get to all that makes Nashville GREAT! So much to do here and a great place to kick it for Valentines Day or St. Pat's. Broadway, Ryman, Bridgestone, Grand Ole Opry,  sports, concerts & fab food scene. Steps from Shelby Park with walking/biking. Restaurants, bars & shopping districts galore, including Five Points. Full kitchen, separate bedroom/bath, gated off-street parking, patio, cable/high-speed internet - all completely private. See y'all soon!

The space
Open concept Living Room and Kitchen. Kitchen is well-equipped. Bedroom with Bathroom is semi-private and Living Room has extra twin-size, pull-out bed. Bathroom has shower/tub, blow dryer, toiletries, night light, bath scale and more. Stacked washer and dryer

Other things to note
The guesthouse is above our garage and adjacent to the guests' gated off-street parking with a separate entrance. The patio is available for guest use and the entire property is fenced and gated.
